subject: Warp Grids Representing Min and Max values of PCs On PCA Graph

messages.author: a9c2ab5e10ef38e3
messages.subject: Warp Grids Representing Min and Max values of PCs On PCA Graph
parts:
Hi there,

Recently updated to the newest version of geomorph and realised that with the depreciation of plotTangentSpace my previous code to show the landmark configuration at the extreme ends of my PCs in my PCA plot warped to my mean shape no longer work, and I can't work out how to recreate it with the data from gm.prcomp, and I was wondering if it was possible, how I could do it?

My code at the moment is:

mat <- matrix(c(4,5,0,1,1,2,1,1,3), 3)
layout(mat, widths=c(1,1,1), heights=c(1,1,0.6))
par(mar=c(4, 4, 1, 1))
plot(Lineages.PCA, warpgrids=TRUE, pch=21, cex=1.9, bg=Country_col.gp, xlab=xlab, ylab=ylab, cex.lab = 1.45, cex.axis = 1.4, asp=T)
legend("topright", legend= unique(Countries.gp), pch=19, col=unique(Country_col.gp), cex=1.32, pt.cex = 2.4, text.width=0.1, y.intersp=0.9)
ref <- mshape(Lineages.gpa$coords)


Here is the part that no longer works, as the pc.shapes part no longer exists.

par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plotRefToTarget(ref,Lineages.PCA$pc.shapes$PC1min, links = links)
Lineages.PCA$
# Item 3
plotRefToTarget(ref,Lineages.PCA$pc.shapes$PC1max, links = links)
# Item 4
plotRefToTarget(ref,Lineages.PCA$pc.shapes$PC2min, links = links)
# Item 5
plotRefToTarget(ref,Lineages.PCA$pc.shapes$PC2max, links = links)

Any help you could give me here would be greatly appreciated.

Best wishes,

Chris

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Warp Grids Representing Min and Max values of PCs On PCA Graph
parts:
Chris,

please read vignette("geomorph.PCA") to get familiar with how the new function works.

Essentially, regarding your question, the names of the pieces have changed so they are now called e.g. PCA$shapes$shapes.comp1$min etc. A look into the output object of the function will allow you to infer the rest, I believe.

Antigoni
